assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to these embolic events
The claim was denied under Reason Code PR-204
The documented indication supports the medical necessity of this service for the diagnoses G45.9, I34.0, and Z86.73
